# Repo

Repo — `repo` argümanı, yoksa `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`, yoksa sunucunun cwd'si; git kökü. MCP `roots` 2026-07-28'de kullanımdan kalktı, kullanılmaz.

Alternative: resolving the repo through the MCP `roots` mechanism, rejected because `roots` was deprecated in the 2026-07-28 spec revision; the `repo` argument, `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`, or the server's cwd are used instead.
